title: rosa viscaria var. oblongicarpa
intro: Rosa viscaria var. oblongicarpa, commonly known as the alpine rose, is a plant species within the rose family that is native to mountainous regions of Europe. The health benefits of Rosa viscaria var. oblongicarpa include its ability to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation, making it a potential treatment for various gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bitter compounds, which stimulate digestive secretions and relax the smooth muscles in the gastrointestinal tract. The bioactive constituents of Rosa viscaria var. oblongicarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
